provenance.asset_description: A sqare image with two individual figures overlayed over a blurred background. In the top right corner, a kasatha solarian stands tall, surrounded by ominous looking energy, with glowing red eyes, purple armor, monstrous appendages, and wielding a shadow cannon. In the bottom left corner, A pale skinned, dark-haired bearded man in weathered armor holds a wicked axe at the ready as he prepares to channel offensive magic through it.
